pages.title: A New Journey
pages.text: Pack the book. There is time to discover the road together.

pages.title: Receiving the Guide
pages.text: When you first enter a world, you receive this guide and the New Journey advancement. Travelers returning to an older world receive them too.$(br2)The guide is not given again on respawn, but you can craft a replacement.

pages.title: A Closer Companion!
pages.text: A different shape. The same eyes you know.

pages.title: The First Transformation
pages.text: Name your companion, wait until it reaches stage three, and help it accumulate 300 knowledge. The first time your own dragon takes human form, you earn A Closer Companion!$(br2)Find an open place and take a look at its new form.

pages.title: Maid for Hunting
pages.text: The first hunt together deserves a page of its own.

pages.title: The First Hunt
pages.text: When your companion first defeats a monster in human form, you earn Maid for Hunting while online. A claw, breath, or elemental charge can all mark the occasion.$(br2)Even a chance encounter on the road deserves a place in the book.

pages.title: A Trinity of Dragons
pages.text: Frost, fire and thunder, each with a familiar face walking beside you.

pages.title: Viewing Advancements
pages.text: Open the game's Advancements screen to revisit these moments. Their keepsake pictures are here in the book too.
